review_scope: Three development cards, 44 fact rows, 9 transmission edges, calculation specs and rendered page. Review does not establish causal or predictive validity.

findings.original_expression: CoreWeave edges used origin/destination keys and omitted event_id.
findings.issue: Cross-card edge contract could not check event identity and would reject the frozen draft.
findings.correction: Mapped origin/destination to from/to and added the frozen CoreWeave event_id on each of four edges; no substantive causal claim changed.

findings.issue: The English companion card records completion at 2026-11-15T02:04:20Z; the manifest time was too early for the bilingual pair.
findings.correction: Set the selection manifest's displayed analysis creation to 02:04:20Z while retaining the earlier Chinese-card timestamp in that card.

findings.original_expression: Initial impact page displayed unit codes such as USD million_cash_outflow_magnitude and a raw CPI embargo precision code.
findings.issue: Main-card numbers and time basis were difficult to read and could blur scheduled/official time with independently observed first publication.
findings.correction: Added human-readable highlighted units and event-specific time-basis notes; retained exact raw units and precision in the fact tables/manifest.

findings.original_expression: Initial page tagged CPI_F08/CPI_F09 null year-on-year values as SOURCE_FACT.
findings.issue: A known source omission was visually labelled as a measured fact even though the values were unknown.
findings.correction: Status-based display now labels these rows SOURCE_MISSING and prints unknown, never zero.

findings.original_expression: The initial page banner stated no price evaluation but did not separately show news tone, fundamental interpretation and actual price-response states on each card.
findings.issue: A reader could conflate a conditional fundamental path with measured sentiment or a market outcome.
findings.correction: Added an explicit three-layer status line to every final card: news tone NOT_SCORED, fundamental impact AI_ANALYST_DRAFT, actual price response NOT_RUN.

counterevidence_checklist.check: Unsupported numbers or specific company relationships
counterevidence_checklist.finding: Six saved official files replayed by SHA and short excerpts; specific unnamed vendors/customers remain at industry level. Financing terms and market consensus remain UNKNOWN.

counterevidence_checklist.check: Later information treated as known at event time
counterevidence_checklist.finding: CoreWeave's later 10-Q was excluded. Same-day presentation ordering and independent first visibility remain unknown; all cards distinguish event date, retrieval and draft creation.
NVIDIA prior issuer outlook, CoreWeave restated prior outlook and CPI prior official reading are not labelled market consensus; qualified prerelease consensus is UNKNOWN.
Economic transmission edges retain assumptions, falsifiers and watch variables; only issuer-stated or mechanical edges use SOURCE_SUPPORTED.

counterevidence_checklist.check: Quarter/cumulative, currency, GAAP or adjustment basis mixed
counterevidence_checklist.finding: NVIDIA GAAP actual, issuer non-GAAP FCF and guidance are distinct; CoreWeave company-defined CapEx, cash purchases and finance-lease inclusion are distinct; CPI SA monthly and NSA annual gaps are distinct.
Same-quarter cash-flow accounting, future revenue scenarios, and mixed macro-rate scenarios identify different channels and horizons; no return outcome is claimed.

remaining_limits: No independent human gold or causal identification
No qualified issuer-security admission or return labels
Current captures are not independently witnessed release-time snapshots
